items.title: Ex-Hospital Director Mulling Legal Action Against Transfer: Lawyer
items.summary: An ex-hospital director's lawyer says her client is considering legal action against the government over his transfer to JKN Sabah because he wasn't given the right to be heard, nor informed about the findings of an internal probe into sexual harassment. items.title: Expert: Scrap MediAsas For Excluding Pre-Existing Conditions, Seven-Year ‘No Look-Back’
items.summary: Health financing expert Syed Aljunid wants MediAsas axed due to its pre-existing condition exclusions and 7-year moratorium before "no look-back" kicks in, saying MediAsas is no different from private health insurance. items.title: Private Hospitals See Rise In Dengue Fever Admissions
items.summary: Admissions to private hospitals for dengue fever have jumped this year, similar to public hospitals. APHM advises the public to seek early consultation for high fever, severe headache, joint/muscle pain, or rash, to prevent serious dengue complications. The post Private Hospitals See Rise In Dengue Fever Admissions appeared first on CodeBlue .

items.title: Over 6,200 Medical Officers Quit From 2021 To 2025: Dzulkefly
items.summary: 6,212 medical officers quit in 5 years from 2021 to 2025, comprising 4,380 contract and 1,832 permanent. Although contract MO resignations have been dropping annually from 2023, resignations of permanent MOs rose every year from 238 in 2021 to 498 in 2025. The post Over 6,200 Medical Officers Quit From 2021 To 2025: Dzulkefly appeared first on CodeBlue .
